cs.t:
I have spinal issues, and chairs were a serious issue. I tried and rejected Ikea Markus and several hi-techy beefy chairs, because sitting in a soft & comfortable chair always ended in spinal aches. I figured out I felt better in chairs that made you sit straight and not lean at all, neither sideways, nor backwards, plus swaying and moving a bit, changing posture every couple minutes is a benefit. (Markus chair has thick seat, which gets in the way of legs when you try to turn left/right.) For now, I chose Bleckberget, a similar model to the one in the comment above. US:  https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/bleckberget-swivel-chair-idekul... 
RU:  https://www.ikea.com/ru/ru/p/bleckberget-blekberget-rabochiy...  In the office, this type of chair also worked, but at home it didn't (probably, at home I tend to lean more and sit in a more "relaxed" way):  https://office-gr.ru/image/cache/catalog/byurokrat/444/333/8...
